name: grid
description: Renders 1..N cards in a responsive auto-fit grid: one card fills the row, additional cards share available columns, and narrow widths collapse to one column. Each card may carry a title, description, image, link, an onClick handler (link or reply), and 0..N explicit action buttons (each link or reply). Use for image-led or browseable result sets where the visual layout helps scanning.

items.description: Required. JSON-encoded array of card objects. Each object: { title?, description?, image?, link?, onClick?: { link } | { reply }, actions?: [{ label, link } | { label, reply }] }. Array must be non-empty; empty arrays render a placeholder.

title.description: Optional. Header text rendered above the grid (e.g. 'Headphones under €250').
